subject: maths
title: Lattice multiplication
prompts: Cells: 24, 18. Tens above; units below. Diagram: Editable lattice 43 × 6
Start at the bottom right: 8 → write 8 1 + 4 = 5 → write 5 2 → write 2

questions.subject: maths
questions.hint: For the 4 × 6 cell, where should the tens and units of the product go?
questions.method_note: The 4 × 6 cell is 24: 2 in the tens half and 4 in the units half. Read the final digits down the left edge and along the bottom.
questions.error_note: Check the 4 × 6 cell. Its product is 24; reversing its halves changes the place value. Put 2 above and 4 below the diagonal.
